arg.name: project
arg.description: the project: a directory or pkg://<package>; empty: the working directory's

arg.name: seat
arg.description: a seat number or auto; empty: the host settings' seat:

arg.name: simulator
arg.description: carla or isaac; empty: the project's simulator:

arg.name: map
arg.description: the map the stack's pilots start on; empty: the first run's (CARLA), the first the project's scenarios name (Isaac)

arg.name: gpu
arg.description: the GPU index; empty: the seat's

arg.name: stack_args
arg.description: name:=value ... for stack.launch.py, after swb's own (they win)
